offsite_invite.says: the offsite invitation to one team; each member answers yes or no

offsite_reminder.says: one friendly reminder to a team that the offsite invitation is still open

venue_request.says: asks a venue from our supplier list whether it is free on the offsite day and what the day costs

venue_booking.says: books a venue for the offsite day at its quoted price

catering_order.says: orders the offsite catering for the confirmed headcount

offsite_details.says: the final offsite details (date, venue, time) to one team
